A descriptive flexfield defines the meaning and validation for a set of generic attribute columns on a particular entity. The customer can define these fields for their business purpose. Descriptive Flexifield definition includes assigning names/descriptions and validation to some or all of the generic columns.

privileges.name: Manage Application Document Sequence
privileges.description: Manage implementation of Application Document Sequences. Document Sequences are identifiers guarenteed to be unique, time-ordered, and gapless.  This is in contrast to a database sequence which (for performance purposes) may contain gaps and which might not be ordered by time of document creation.  Examples would include ID numbers for traffic tickets or other legal documents where gaps in the record may trigger an investigation.

privileges.name: Unlink Referenced Work Definition

For example, granting this privilege to an individual with a view privilege permits the viewing of supplier contracts. Granting this privilege to an individual with the delete contracts privilege permits the deletion of supplier contracts.

privileges.name: Manage Application Extensible Flexfield
privileges.description: Manage implementation of the Extensible Flexfield feature on a given entity.

privileges.name: Manage Application Flexfield Value Set
privileges.description: Allows management of value sets to validate the content of a flexfield segment. Value sets provide declarative validation for use in applications flexfield attributes and key segments.

privileges.name: Manage Application Message
privileges.description: Manage an end-user message, shown in the User Interface.  Messages can have different types, such as Error, Warning, Information.  Messages are translated and can be re-used across products.  Exampe:  "File not found", "Table 'TABLE' does not exist".

privileges.name: Manage Application Set-Enabled Lookup
privileges.description: Manage sub-type entities stored in the Application Set-Enabled Lookup entity.  Lookup Types are lists of values such as Days of the Week or Yes/No which can be used to validate column values.

privileges.name: Manage Application Standard Lookup
privileges.description: Manage sub-type entities stored in the Application Standard Lookup Values entity.  Lookup Types are lists of values such as "Days of the Week" or "Yes/No" which can be used to validate columns values.

privileges.name: Run Applied Receipts Journal

privileges.name: Run Customer Balance Revaluation Report

privileges.name: Run Document Number Audit Report
privileges.description: Generate information that identifies missing document sequence numbers.

privileges.name: Run Invoices Posted to Suspense report
privileges.description: Generate all transactions that have revenue amounts posted to suspense accounts as a result of running AutoInvoice.

privileges.name: Run Miscellaneous Receipt Register
privileges.description: Generate information on miscellaneous receipts and credit card refunds.

privileges.name: Run On Account Credit Memo Gain and Loss Journal
privileges.description: Generate on-account credit memo gain and loss journal information needed to reconcile the accounts receivable subledger with the general ledger.

privileges.name: Run Open Balances Revaluation Report
privileges.description: Generate information for creating manual journal entries to revalue open receivable balances.

privileges.name: Run Open Items Revaluation Report
privileges.description: Generate information that determines the amount needed to manually adjust general ledger account balances to reflect the difference between the original and revalued customer open items.

privileges.name: Run Other Receipt Applications Report
privileges.description: Generate all receipt applications that only impact cash balances and not customer open receivables.

privileges.name: Run Potential Reconciling Items Report
privileges.description: Generate journal items that may potentially post to incorrect GL accounts.

privileges.name: Run Projected Gains and Losses Report
privileges.description: Compare the revalued amount of each customer debit item with the entered amount and print the projected unrealized gain or loss.

privileges.name: Run Receipt Journal
privileges.description: Generate receipt journal information needed to reconcile the accounts receivable subledger with the general ledger.

privileges.name: Run Receipt Register
privileges.description: Generate all standard and miscellaneous receipts that affect transaction balances in a selected period.

privileges.name: Run Receivables Aging Report
privileges.description: Generate information about outstanding receivables by general ledger account as of a specific date.

privileges.name: Run Receivables Journal Entries Report
privileges.description: Generate information needed to reconcile the accounts receivable subledger with the general ledger.

privileges.name: Run Receivables to General Ledger Reconciliation Report
privileges.description: Generate information that highlights discrepancies between receivables transactional reconciliation and receivables to general ledger accounting reconciliation.

privileges.name: Run Revenue Recognition
privileges.description: Generate the revenue distribution records for invoices and credit memos that use invoicing and revenue scheduling rules.

privileges.name: Run Sales Journal By Customer
privileges.description: Generate sales by customer journal information needed to reconcile the accounts receivable subledger with the general ledger.

privileges.name: Run Sales Journal by GL Account Report
privileges.description: Generate sales by general ledger account journal information needed to reconcile the accounts receivable subledger with the general ledger.

privileges.name: Run Trading Community Hierarchy Audit Job
privileges.description: Allows the running of the audit process which validates trading community hierarchies against a set of validation rules. If a hierarchy does not pass a validation rule, the hierarchy is updated to an inactive status.

privileges.name: Run Transaction Check Register
privileges.description: Generate information to verify the accuracy of transaction information and indicate which user last updated each item.

privileges.name: Run Transaction Register
privileges.description: Generate information on all transactions that increase or decrease the outstanding balance of selected customers for a specified period, including transactions that do not post or age.

privileges.name: Run Unapplied and Unresolved Receipts Journal
privileges.description: Generate unapplied receipt journal information needed to reconcile the accounts receivable subledger with the general ledger.

privileges.name: Run Unapplied and Unresolved Receipts Register
privileges.description: Generate detailed information about customer on-account and unapplied payments for a specified date range.
